exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, alternative A: AI Order Intake & Exception Handling

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.292 CLI on WSL2 with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), effort high, permission mode auto. Python 3.12, uv 0.11.2, pytest, ruff.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No Claude Code plugin, IDE extension or MCP server was used for this exercise; the plugins enabled at user level are therefore not copied.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: openai/gpt-6-luna via OpenRouter, with OpenAI direct as fallback. reasoning effort low, seed 7, max_completion_tokens 4000, tool_choice required, max 6 calls per request, one repair retry, 60 s timeout, provider-default temperature.

skills.notes: The starter-pack data-generation skill was read and followed as guidance while extending the dataset. The user-level `fastapi` skill was invoked after the build to review the web layer; it found two defects, which were fixed. No custom skills were created.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Project CLAUDE.md, the relevant sections of the user-level CLAUDE.md, and one agent memory note. No subagents were used.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: Two user-level PreToolUse hooks were active: attribution stripping, and an rtk command rewriter (third-party token-saving CLI). The project scripts are run manually, not as hooks.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Application system prompt: v1 in eceda71, v2 in bcb1c4c (clarification wording).

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Application tools: search_catalog and submit_order_draft, strict JSON schema. Development: Claude Code built-in tools only (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, AskUserQuestion). The MCP connectors present in the session were not used.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Read-deny rules for .env files kept the assistant from reading the API key. Variable names are listed; values are never stored.
